question: If θ = 45°, then what will be the value of frac{{sin theta + cos theta }}{{sin theta - cos theta }}?
solution:
Given:

θ = 45°

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7101c0b0abb47943f7af05e7717b345d90417692003038950f420fac7962f7.png] 

Calculation: 

frac{{sin theta + cos theta }}{{sin theta - cos theta }}

⇒ {{(Sin 45° + Cos 45°)} over {(Sin 45° - Cos 45°)} }

⇒ {({1 over sqrt2} + {1 over sqrt2} )} over {({1 over sqrt2} - {1 over sqrt2} )}

⇒ ∞ 

∴ The required answer is ∞ .
